title: LoRA-Diffusion: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning via Low-Rank Trajectory Decomposition
abstract: arXiv:2608.12328v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods such as LoRA have transformed the adaptation of large autoregressive language models, enabling task-specific customization with substantially fewer trainable parameters. However, these methods have not been successfully extended to diffusion-based language models, which generate text through iterative denoising rather than sequential token prediction. We propose LoRA-Diffusion, a parameter-efficient fine-tuning approach that applies low-rank decomposition to the denoising trajectory instead of model weights. Unlike weight-based LoRA, which modifies individual transformation matrices, our method learns low-rank perturbations to the entire diffusion path from noise to output. We introduce trajectory-level low-rank adapters that modify each denoising step, step-adaptive rank allocation across diffusion phases, and compositional multi-task learning that allows merging task-specific modules at inference

translated_title: LoRA-扩散：通过低秩轨迹分解实现参数高效微调
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12328v1 公告类型：新 摘要：参数高效微调方法，如LoRA，已经改变了大型自回归语言模型的适配方式，使得通过显著更少的可训练参数实现任务特定定制成为可能。然而，这些方法尚未成功扩展到基于扩散的语言模型，这类模型通过迭代去噪而非顺序词元预测来生成文本。我们提出了LoRA-扩散，一种参数高效的微调方法，它将低秩分解应用于去噪轨迹而非模型权重。与基于权重的LoRA（修改单个变换矩阵）不同，我们的方法学习从噪声到输出的整个扩散路径上的低秩扰动。我们引入了轨迹级低秩适配器，以修改每个去噪步骤，跨扩散阶段的步适应秩分配，以及组合式多任务学习，允许在推理时合并任务特定模块。
tldr: 本文提出LoRA-扩散，首次将低秩分解应用于扩散模型的去噪轨迹而非权重，通过轨迹级适配器和步适应秩分配实现参数高效微调，并支持多任务组合。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LoRA-Diffusion, which for the first time applies low-rank decomposition to the denoising trajectory rather than weights in diffusion models, enabling parameter-efficient fine-tuning via trajectory-level adapters and step-adaptive rank allocation, with support for compositional multi-task learning.
